legacy_root.question: What do published routers (cost-quality cascades, learned routers) claim, and has any of the claimed cost saving been reproduced by an independent party on a different task distribution?
legacy_root.answer: Published routers claim large savings — FrugalGPT Table 3 98.3% vs GPT-4 on HEADLINES, RouteLLM Table 6 3.66x vs GPT-4 on MT-Bench at 95% quality, HybridLLM Table 1 40% fewer large-model calls with 0% BART drop on a small-gap Llama-2 pair, AutoMix abstract >50% cost cut — but none of those headline figures has been reproduced by an independent party on a different task distribution. AutoMix independently reimplemented FrugalGPT and HybridLLM on QASPER/QUALITY/COQA/MUTUAL/DIPLOMAT and did not recover 98.3% or 40%/0-drop; FrugalGPT ΔIBC is -16.7 on COQA with Mistral-7B (AutoMix Table 1). RouterBench independently evaluated cascade on MMLU/MBPP/GSM8K (Figure 5) and found gains only when judge error ≤ 0.1. Commercial Martian/Unify have no retrieved DOI/section/baseline; RouteLLM Figure 2 is a competitor overlay. Therefore the per-router replication-status column is self-reported-only or unknown, every headline saving is E3, and no mechanism is promoted.

claims.claim: FrugalGPT LLM cascade reports 98.3% inference-cost reduction while matching GPT-4 accuracy (FrugalGPT cost 0.6 vs GPT-4 cost 33.1 in paper units) on HEADLINES (financial news gold-price classification; Chen et al. Table 2: 10000 examples) (locus Table 3 row HEADLINES; also Figure 1(c) caption).

source_lineage.figure_locus: Table 3 row HEADLINES; also Figure 1(c) caption

independent_reruns.distribution: COQA / QASPER / QUALITY / MUTUAL / DIPLOMAT (not HEADLINES)
independent_reruns.result: FrugalGPT-style DistilBERT cascade reimplemented as a baseline. Mistral-7B SLM: ΔIBC -16.7 on COQA, +16.8 on DIPLOMAT, +7.7 on QASPER. Llama-2-13B SLM: ΔIBC +87.2 on QASPER. The 98.3% HEADLINES saving was not reproduced.

contradiction_support_edges.note: AutoMix Table 1 FrugalGPT ΔIBC -16.7 on COQA / Mistral-7B vs HEADLINES 98.3%.
RouterBench Figure 5 cascade class on MMLU/MBPP/GSM8K; judge-error caveat; no 98%.

reviewer_requirement.reason: Single G-1 worktree session (grok-4.6 / xAI) read both partitions. A second vendor review was not fabricated. Because the requirement is unmet, no mechanism may be promoted even if a figure were E1.

reviewers.finding: Headline savings are self-reported-only. Independent reruns exist for the cascade class (AutoMix Table 1, RouterBench Figure 5) and do not reproduce FrugalGPT 98.3% or HybridLLM 40%/0-drop.

legacy_root.strongest_surviving_counterargument: RouteLLM evaluates on three public benches (MT-Bench, MMLU, GSM8K) and AutoMix/RouterBench re-run cascade-class methods on other distributions, which a reader might call 'independent replication.' Those reruns are real, but they do not reproduce the claimed *figures*: AutoMix's FrugalGPT ΔIBC on COQA is negative, RouterBench reports no 98% cost cut, and RouteLLM's MMLU/GSM8K numbers are still the same authors. The unit's bar is independent reproduction of the claimed saving on a different task distribution, not same-lab extra benches or a failed transfer.

reviewer_requirement.specified: two independent reviewers with PARTITIONED evidence (each gets a disjoint half of the source set); 05-ECO anti-adoption #2 forbids a second same-vendor reviewer on the same input
reviewer_requirement.reason: Single G-1 worktree session (grok-4.6 / xAI) read both partitions. A second vendor review was not fabricated. Because the requirement is unmet, no mechanism may be promoted even if a figure were E1.

reviewers.finding: Headline savings are self-reported-only. Independent reruns exist for the cascade class (AutoMix Table 1, RouterBench Figure 5) and do not reproduce FrugalGPT 98.3% or HybridLLM 40%/0-drop.

strongest_surviving_counterargument: RouteLLM evaluates on three public benches (MT-Bench, MMLU, GSM8K) and AutoMix/RouterBench re-run cascade-class methods on other distributions, which a reader might call 'independent replication.' Those reruns are real, but they do not reproduce the claimed *figures*: AutoMix's FrugalGPT ΔIBC on COQA is negative, RouterBench reports no 98% cost cut, and RouteLLM's MMLU/GSM8K numbers are still the same authors. The unit's bar is independent reproduction of the claimed saving on a different task distribution, not same-lab extra benches or a failed transfer.

controls.why: FrugalGPT, RouteLLM, HybridLLM, AutoMix, and RouterBench cascade figures are author-own.
